source_identity.wp802_semantic: score_delta = intervention.cumulative_score - baseline.cumulative_score; novelty_delta = intervention.unique_public_payload_count - baseline.unique_public_payload_count

hypothesis: Positive probe activity and public-observation novelty are not sufficient evidence of positive decision value in the merged WP802 semantics.
counterhypothesis: Because useful probing increases public novelty in the canonical fixture, novelty/probe activity necessarily co-varies with positive score_delta in WP802.

reproduction.method: Deterministic arithmetic reproduction of exact observed WP800/WP802 source equations using the existing canonical baseline score and bounded hypothetical intermediate evaluator costs. No hidden policy input and no product runtime execution.

interpretation: The current schema already permits novelty/probing to increase while net evaluator utility is neutral or harmful. Therefore novelty/probe count must remain diagnostic and must not be promoted into a success predicate independent of score_delta.

exact_source_execution_attempt.method: local git clone of exact merge followed by existing unittest module

architecture_implication: No scoring-architecture rewrite is supported. The strongest justified delta is one repository regression/negative-control test that instantiates the neutral or harmful probe case and asserts score_delta <= 0 while novelty_delta/probe_delta remain positive.
next_exact_gate: Trigger-4 or an admitted exact-source repository CI lane should add the minimal WP802 negative-control regression and prove it on exact PR-head plus merged-main CI. Until that happens, do not promote this research to E5/E6.
